preservation_map.prior_claim: The [identity design](../../../records/candidates/settlement/KT-settlement-cashflow-identity-and-stella-write-back.md#identity-and-duplicate-handling) preserves Stella IDs. The [[summaries/KT-settlement-auto-netting|auto-netting topic]] explains when netting produces a resultant.

preservation_map.prior_claim: The [FX design](../../../records/candidates/settlement/KT-settlement-cashflow-identity-and-stella-write-back.md#fx-status-write-back) calls for RATAN to update the matched Stella cashflow to `SUSPENDED-MATURED` after named Razor events. This update aims to reduce duplicate payments. The design does not require write-back for netting or split resultants, or for un-net or un-split events. The applicable match fields, tolerances, and trigger set need confirmation.
